reviewer: Pickle: official-source review of the Korea Consumer Agency / KISA IP camera comparison report published 2026-11-12, read together with attachment 1 on 2026-11-20, plus the Personal Information Protection Commission release of 2026-04-22 and three Coupang listings opened live on 2026-11-20
method: Compared the draft against the consumer24 comparison page (infoId=A1081468) and attachment 1 ('IP camera quality comparison test' results) downloaded on 2026-11-20. Test sample: 600 consumers who bought an IP camera in the previous two years (survey December 2025) plus Danaoa, 11st and Coupang rankings, limited to models released within two years with 3 MP or more and wireless connection; 10 brands, with the five most-owned also quality-tested. Prices as of February 2026 for the unit alone: ipTIME C500G 29,900, Dahua DH-H3B 35,000, Xiaomi MJSXJ16CM (C500 PRO) 64,800, Pineview K11 69,000, Tapo TC74 69,800, Heyhome GKW-MC0511 72,900, Hikvision CN-D1153G 73,000, iGloo TSC-443P (S8) 119,000, Vstarcam 800X 159,000, RoboView A7 176,500 won. Security: 37 items (hardware 3, network 5, firmware 11, mobile app 15, policy 3); three products could leak others' footage (RoboView remote activation, Vstarcam other users' image retrieval and theft, Pineview image and video retrieval plus camera control), with KISA follow-up completed for RoboView (reply 2026-07-08) and Pineview (2026-07-10) and in progress for Vstarcam (reply 2026-07-14); four products left UART test terminals active (Vstarcam, iGloo, Pineview, Heyhome); eight lacked secure transport (Dahua, RoboView, Vstarcam, ipTIME, iGloo, Tapo, Pineview, Hikvision); all ten had weak firmware settings and weak app anti-reverse-engineering, five had no safe password policy (Dahua, Vstarcam, Xiaomi, ipTIME, Tapo), five had no vulnerability reporting process (RoboView, ipTIME, iGloo, Pineview, Heyhome), six could not state an update support period (RoboView, Vstarcam, ipTIME, iGloo, Pineview, Heyhome). Overall security grades: Xiaomi, Tapo and Heyhome two stars, Dahua, ipTIME, iGloo and Hikvision one star, RoboView, Vstarcam and Pineview deficient, no three-star product. Quality: sharpness three stars for Xiaomi, ipTIME and iGloo and two for Tapo and Heyhome; colour accuracy three stars for Heyhome and two for the rest; viewing angle 119 degrees (iGloo) to 88 (Heyhome), with Xiaomi 87 to 106 and ipTIME 89 to 96 and Tapo 99; brightness falloff 15 percent (Tapo) to 26 (Xiaomi), with iGloo 20, Heyhome 24 and ipTIME 25; storage 2.4 MB per minute for Heyhome against 5.7 for Xiaomi, 5.3 ipTIME, 5.5 Tapo and 5.0 iGloo, giving 72, 30, 32, 31 and 34 days on a 256 GB card (ipTIME 64 and Tapo 62 days with 512 GB); features: distortion correction on Xiaomi and ipTIME, anti-flicker on ipTIME and iGloo, two-way talk, motion tracking and detection zones on all five. The Personal Information Protection Commission release of 2026-04-22 was read for the 8-character three-type password rule, initial account change advice, certification marks (CIC, TTA Verified, PbD) and the police report of 2025-12-01 on 120,000 hacked cameras and four suspects. Coupang was checked in the signed-in browser on 2026-11-20: Xiaomi C500 Pro 64,800 won free shipping with 91 reviews and 11-26 arrival; ipTIME C500G 37,600 won with free shipping and returns, next-day dawn delivery, 10 reviews, seller EFM Networks; Heyhome Pro+ GKW-MC0511 89,900 won list price with the 12 percent Wow coupon and card discount bringing it to 78,930 won, free shipping and returns, 1,382 reviews, more than 500 buyers in a month. All three AFFSDP deep links were tested and returned 302 to the intended product pages with lptag AF6593875. The article states the 25.8 percent (7,700 won) ipTIME increase since the February test purchase and keeps the affiliate block in one place after the FAQ with no top, inline or sticky box, per the 2026-11-17 approval-first layout.
